  4. Administrative Hearings Bureau

    March 19, 2026, 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM
    @
    City Hall
    Administrative Hearings Bureau 2026-03-19T09:00:00

    The City of Ypsilanti established an Administrative Hearings Bureau (AHB) in August 2010. The AHB helps to define, prevent, reduce, and eliminate blight factors, and causes of blight by adjudicating violations of the Ypsilanti blight ordinance and the 2012 International Property Maintenance Code. Payments for Administrative Hearings Bureau citations, judgments, and motions to set aside are accepted Monday-Friday 8 AM - 4 PM on the first floor of city hall.

    City Hall1 S Huron StYpsilantiMI48197
